app/server.mjs:138-141 — distinct 500 page requested

review_cost.rationale: One round of small-to-medium changes: fix the double-trigger/history bug, fix the 500 page, delete dead code, and adopt the framework's static/escaping helpers. No rework of structure or behavior needed.

findings.issue: Filter form's hx-trigger 'input changed delay:300ms, change' double-fires on <select> changes (both input and change events), issuing duplicate requests and pushing duplicate history entries (hx-push-url at views.mjs:112, HX-Push-Url at server.mjs:62) — back button needs two presses per filter change
findings.suggestion: Use a single debounced trigger (e.g. 'input changed delay:300ms, change changed delay:300ms') or add hx-sync='this:abort'; the moves select at views.mjs:487 already correctly uses one trigger

findings.issue: onError renders the 'Not found' page with HTTP 500, misleading users during API outages; when the error occurs on an htmx partial request, a full HTML document is swapped into the #pokemon-results or table target
findings.suggestion: Return a dedicated 500 error page (or a fragment for HX-Request) distinct from the 404 page

findings.issue: formatValue(row.power/accuracy/pp) interpolated into move-table cells without escapeHtml, while the same values are escaped on the move page (views.mjs:217-219) — inconsistent escaping discipline under a hand-rolled template system
findings.suggestion: Escape consistently, or better, adopt Hono's hono/html tagged template so escaping is automatic everywhere

findings.issue: Hand-rolled static asset serving (files read into memory at startup, custom c.body routes) instead of serveStatic from @hono/node-server/serve-static, and no Cache-Control headers on immutable assets
findings.suggestion: Use serveStatic({ root: './public/' }) with a Cache-Control header; delete readPublicFile

findings.issue: Dead code: renderMovePageByName/renderAbilityPageByName/renderTypePageByName duplicate the fetch+render orchestration that server.mjs:77-95 does inline; englishEffect (api.mjs:42) is also unused
findings.suggestion: Delete the unused exports, or conversely use them in the routes so data loading lives in one place

findings.issue: Three overlapping cache mechanisms: the fetchJson cache+pending map, memoize for catalogs, and versionGroupCache which just duplicates fetchJson's per-URL cache
findings.suggestion: Drop versionGroupCache (apiGet already caches) and document the two deliberate layers

findings.issue: views.mjs mixes data-loading orchestration (getHomeData, getMovesData at :393, getPokemonPageData at :534) with all page rendering, while server.mjs also loads data for move/ability/type routes — responsibility split two ways
findings.suggestion: Move data loading into a data/loader module (or into the routes) so views are pure render functions

findings.issue: The move-table sort endpoint refetches/rebuilds the entire Pokémon page data (species, default Pokémon, evolution chain, all move details for the game) just to re-render one table
findings.suggestion: Persist the already-built movesData (or accept sort state and rows via query params) so a sort click doesn't redo full page data assembly

findings.issue: 404 responses are cached as null permanently, so a transient API miss stays 'not found' for the process lifetime even though the spec treats the API as live data
findings.suggestion: Don't cache nulls (or use a TTL for negative results)

findings.issue: No hx-sync/abort strategy on the live search form, so a slow earlier response can overwrite the results of a newer keystroke
findings.suggestion: Add hx-sync='this:abort' on the form to make the newest request win

summary: A solid, careful implementation on the current stable Hono and htmx: spec details are handled thoroughly, escaping and 404 handling are mostly disciplined, and the htmx partial/push-URL contract is done the documented way. The main merge blockers are a user-visible double-trigger/double-history-push bug on the filter form and the 500-as-not-found fallback. Beyond those it's a normal review round: hand-rolled static serving and HTML escaping where Hono ships serveStatic and hono/html, a god-module views file with dead duplicated loaders, and three overlapping cache layers.
